mira: Quick sync — running a lookahead-commitment sweep on ozma-14b-q4b. latency drops ~18% but top-1 accuracy on LRA holdouts slipped ~2.3%.
ken: Can you paste the exact config? window/horizon params maybe too aggressive.
mira: Using `commit_horizon=16`, `lookahead_k=4`, `speculative_prob=0.45` on nightly canary. Eval command:
```
python -m onboard.eval --model ozma-14b-q4b --dataset lra-holdouts --commit_horizon 16 --lookahead_k 4 --spec_prob 0.45 --batch 64
```
alex: that spec_prob is high for quantized kv. Q4B can amplify small distrib shifts -> logprob drift.
jas: do we have token-level logprob delta plots? that's easiest signal for commit-induced bias.
mira: added a quick plot in artifacts but tl;dr: mean token logprob decreased by ~0.08 on reasoning tasks, and SD up by 0.02. Some rare tokens show >0.5 shift.
ken: interesting — could be rounding in KV reads when speculative branch pulls stale cache entries. Did you try `commit_horizon=8`?
mira: yes. Horizon=8 gives ~10% latency gain, only 0.6% accuracy drop. tradeoff might be acceptable for some routes.
jas: propose systematic eval plan: three axes: horizon, lookahead_k, quant (q4b vs q3f16). grid: horizon [4,8,12,16], k [1,2,4], quant [q4b,q3f16]. use paired bootstrap on metric (exact-match / pass@1 / logp-shift).
alex: +1. Also include a diversity holdout set to catch hallucination amplification.
ops-bot: deploy:canary started for ozma-14b-q4b with commit_horizon=8, lookahead_k=2 by mira
mira: running canary now. early numbers look promising. also putting together a short writeup with examples where the model rewrites earlier tokens after a speculative commit — weird cases.
ken: capture failures and tag prompts that flip answers. we'll use them as targeted regressions for rollouts.
jas: minor note: when computing latency, include end-to-end prefix warmup cost (first request after cold start spikes). otherwise horizon effects are overstated.
mira: good call. I'll rerun bench with cold-start bucket and warm steady-state bucket.
alex: last ask: include partial-rollout script for traffic split 10/90 and automatic rollback on accuracy drop >1.5%.
mira: ack, adding rollout config. will paste the notebook and raw logs in the thread when done. :thumbsup:
